name: Mole Meter
tagline: Soil analytics for people who talk to their tomatoes.
positioning: Mole Meter turns a cheap probe and your phone into lab-grade soil readings, so your garden runs on data instead of vibes and hunches.

hero.h1: Know what your dirt is actually doing.
hero.sub: Stick the probe in, scan the code, and get nitrogen, pH, moisture, and microbe reads in under a minute. No lab, no clipboard, no soil-science degree required.

features.title: Readings in 60 seconds
features.description: Probe hits the soil, app hits the cloud. Nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, pH, and moisture back before your coffee gets cold.

features.title: Trends, not one-offs
features.description: Every reading stacks into a timeline, so you can spot the exact week your compost started working — or quietly stopped.

features.title: Zone your whole yard
features.description: Tag raised beds, pots, and that cursed patch by the fence. Mole Meter tracks each one on its own so nothing gets lumped together.

features.title: Alerts before things die
features.description: Get pinged when moisture tanks or pH drifts, instead of finding out from a sad, crispy basil plant three days too late.

features.title: Plant-matched targets
features.description: Tell it what you're growing and it hands you the exact numbers to hit. No more guessing what 'slightly acidic' is supposed to mean.

features.title: Works offline in the mud
features.description: Cache readings out in the field and sync when you're back on wifi. Your garden doesn't have bars — we planned for that.

testimonials.quote: I used to fertilize on vibes and a hunch. Now I know my back bed is starving for potassium and the front is fine. My tomatoes have never been so smug.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: Killed three raised beds before this. Mole Meter flagged that my pH was basically battery acid in week one. Beds four through nine are thriving.
testimonials.name: Marcus Elling

testimonials.quote: I run a community garden with 40 plots and zero budget for a real soil lab. This paid for itself the first spring, and the volunteers stopped arguing about lime.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: One probe, one garden, all the essentials.
For people whose garden is a full-blown lifestyle.
Small plots, market beds, and CSA operations.

homepage.footerBlurb: Mole Meter is soil analytics for people who take dirt personally. Fewer dead plants, more data, and absolutely zero lab coats.
